units.source_en: From Sekigahara through Surusumi and onward to Nagahama and Kinomoto was a journey of roughly a hundred li.
units.source_zh: 从关原穿过春照，再赶到长滨、木本，大约有百里路程。

units.source_en: Yet if Hideyoshi had truly crossed the river to attack Gifu Castle, then his return to Kinomoto would take precisely as long as Sakuma Morimasa had calculated: even at the fastest pace, he could not arrive for another three days.
units.source_zh: 可是，倘若秀吉真的渡河向岐阜城发起攻击，返回木本的时间正好跟佐久间盛政所计算的一样，再快也得在三日之后。

paragraphs.source_zh: 队伍路过关原，天已经漆黑一片了，道路的两边点燃了明亮的火把。从关原穿过春照，再赶到长滨、木本，大约有百里路程。可是，倘若秀吉真的渡河向岐阜城发起攻击，返回木本的时间正好跟佐久间盛政所计算的一样，再快也得在三日之后。

paragraphs.source_en: Around the Hour of the Dog, the column left Surusumi and passed through Nomura, Sonshōji, Odani, Mase, and Inokuchi. It was already deep into the latter half of the night when they reached Kinomoto. Meanwhile, the supply units also returned one after another from Nagahama to Kinomoto.

units.source_en: Around the Hour of the Dog, the column left Surusumi and passed through Nomura, Sonshōji, Odani, Mase, and Inokuchi. It was already deep into the latter half of the night when they reached Kinomoto.
units.source_zh: 戌时左右，队伍从春照出发，经过野村、尊胜寺、小谷、马上、井口，到达木本已经是后半夜了。

units.source_en: Meanwhile, the supply units also returned one after another from Nagahama to Kinomoto.
units.source_zh: 另一方面，粮秣部队也相继从长滨赶回了木本。

paragraphs.source_zh: 戌时左右，队伍从春照出发，经过野村、尊胜寺、小谷、马上、井口，到达木本已经是后半夜了。另一方面，粮秣部队也相继从长滨赶回了木本。

paragraphs.source_en: Fifteen thousand soldiers had covered a hundred li in only a few hours—truly astonishing speed. Thus, from Surusumi to Kinomoto, and from Hachiminesan onward to the Mino highway, long dragons of torchlight stretched everywhere. Seen from afar, they resembled a festival of ten thousand lanterns and were extraordinarily beautiful. Hideyoshi was the first to reach Kinomoto.

units.source_en: Fifteen thousand soldiers had covered a hundred li in only a few hours—truly astonishing speed.
units.source_zh: 一万五千士兵仅仅用了几个时辰，就走完了百里路程，真是神速。

units.source_en: Thus, from Surusumi to Kinomoto, and from Hachiminesan onward to the Mino highway, long dragons of torchlight stretched everywhere. Seen from afar, they resembled a festival of ten thousand lanterns and were extraordinarily beautiful.
units.source_zh: 因此，从春照到木本，从钵峰再到美浓官道，全都是火把的长龙，就像万灯会似的，远远望去，格外迷人。

units.source_en: Hideyoshi was the first to reach Kinomoto.
units.source_zh: 秀吉最先抵达木本。

paragraphs.source_zh: 一万五千士兵仅仅用了几个时辰，就走完了百里路程，真是神速。因此，从春照到木本，从钵峰再到美浓官道，全都是火把的长龙，就像万灯会似的，远远望去，格外迷人。秀吉最先抵达木本。

paragraphs.source_en: Hideyoshi moved ceaselessly about, calling out in a loud, confident voice, like an untiring man with three heads and six arms.

units.source_en: Hideyoshi moved ceaselessly about, calling out in a loud, confident voice, like an untiring man with three heads and six arms.
units.source_zh: 秀吉转来转去，大声喊话，充满了自信，仿佛一个永不知疲劳的三头六臂之人。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀吉转来转去，大声喊话，充满了自信，仿佛一个永不知疲劳的三头六臂之人。
